title: 5 stars!
text: This was an easy, laid-back day trip with a great balance of sightseeing and downtime. Tarragona’s Roman ruins were impressive and didn’t feel overcrowded. Sitges was a perfect change of pace, with time to wander the beach, explore the town, and grab a relaxed meal. Having it as a private tour made everything feel flexible and unhurried. Overall, it was a really enjoyable way to see more of the area without the stress of planning.
author: J5169OYcaroliner
